```{r}
library(rmatio)
library(viridis)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggpubr)
library(gridExtra)
library(ggplot2)
library(ConsensusClusterPlus)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(RTN)

setwd("/Users/markdings/Documents/PhD/Scripts")
load("decoder_eacZalm6/eac.bijlsma.186.s4b.Rda")

eset = data$expression_set
list.coph = list()
for (i in c(2:11)) {
  a = i-1
  if (!file.exists(paste0("/Users/markdings/Documents/PhD/Scripts/decoder_eacZalm6/K",i, "_res.mat"))) {
    list.coph[[a]] = 0
  } else {
  ds = read.mat(paste0("/Users/markdings/Documents/PhD/Scripts/decoder_eacZalm6/K",i, "_res.mat"))
  list.coph[[a]] = ds$coph
  }
}

plot(x = 3:11, y = list.coph[2:length(list.coph)], type = "o")

```

```{r}
k=7
ds = read.mat(paste0("/Users/markdings/Documents/PhD/Scripts/decoder_eacZalm6//K",k, "_res.mat"))
rownames(ds$genesigs) = rownames(eset)
features <- c(sprintf("f%02d", seq(1,ncol(ds$genesigs))))
colnames(ds$genesigs) <- features; rm(features)

colnames(ds$samplesigs) = colnames(eset)
table = ds$samplesigs

factor = apply(ds$genesigs, 1, function(x) which.max(x))
ds$genesigs = cbind(factor,ds$genesigs); rm(factor)

list.topGenes = list()
for (f in 2:ncol(ds$genesigs)) {
  i = f-1
  print(i)
  temp = ds$genesigs[ds$genesigs[,1] == i,]
  distance = c(rep(0,nrow(temp)))
  temp = as.data.frame(cbind(distance, temp))
  
  featuresMatrix = temp[,3:dim(temp)[2]]
  
  for (g in 1:dim(featuresMatrix)[1]){
    maxWeight = max(featuresMatrix[g,])
    secMaxWeight = max(sort(featuresMatrix[g,],partial=dim(featuresMatrix)[2])[dim(featuresMatrix)[2]-1])
    dist = maxWeight - secMaxWeight
    temp$distance[g] = maxWeight - secMaxWeight
  }
  temp = temp[order(-temp$distance), , drop = FALSE]
  feature.top250 = rownames(temp)[1:250]
  list.topGenes[i] = as.data.frame(c(feature.top250))
}
for (i in 1:length(list.topGenes)) {
  print(paste0("cluster: ", i))
  print(unlist(list.topGenes[[i]])[1:10])
  toPrint = unlist(list.topGenes[[i]])[1:250]
  #write.csv(file = paste0("signatureGene.feature",i,".txt") , toPrint)
}

```

```{r}
require("ggrepel")
head(temp, n=20)
temp$rank = 0
for (i in 1:length(temp$rank)) {
  temp$rank[i]=i
}

temp$name = rownames(temp)

data("tfsData")
tfs <- intersect(tfsData$all$SYMBOL, rownames(data$expression_set))

temp$isTF = rownames(temp) %in% tfs
temp$isTF = as.character(temp$isTF)
#temp$isTF[temp$f03> 2& temp$distance>.9&temp$isTF=="TRUE"]= "SIG"
temp = temp[order(temp$distance,decreasing = T),]
temp$isTF[rownames(temp)=="GATA6"]= "SIG"

#pdf("/Users/markdings/Documents/PhD/Scripts/decoder_eacZalm6/GATA6.f03.pdf", height = 2.44, width = 4.23)
ggplot(temp, aes(y=f03,x=distance,color=isTF))+ 
  geom_point(aes(alpha=isTF))+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("FALSE"='#999999',"TRUE"='#444444',"SIG"="red"))+
  scale_alpha_manual(values=c("FALSE"=0.2,"TRUE"=0.8,"SIG"=0.8))+
  theme_minimal()+
  geom_text_repel(
    data = subset(temp, isTF=="SIG"),
    aes(label = name),
    colour = "black",
    size = 3.5,
    box.padding = unit(0.6, "lines")
  )
#dev.off()
```

```{r}
#reduce expression set size:
## Load only adenocarcinoma samples
load("/Users/markdings/Documents/PhD/Scripts/decoder_eacZalm8/eac.bijlsma.156.s4b.eac.Rda")

eset = data$expression_set
eset$var = apply(eset, 1, var)
plot(density(eset$var));abline(v=0.45, col="blue")
eset = eset[eset$var > 0.45,]
eset$var=NULL
```


```{r}
tfs.ofInterest = temp$name[temp$isTF=="SIG"]
rtni <- tni.constructor(expData = as.matrix(eset), 
                        regulatoryElements = tfs.ofInterest, 
                        rowAnnotation = data$probes, 
                        colAnnotation = data$info)
rtni <- tni.permutation(rtni, nPermutations = 100, pValueCutoff = 0.005)
rtni <- tni.bootstrap(rtni)
rtni <- tni.dpi.filter(rtni)
```
```{r}
f.no=1
genes.f = as.data.frame(list.topGenes[[f.no]][1:250]);colnames(genes.f) = "genes"
  
rtna <- tni2tna.preprocess(object = rtni, 
                             phenotype = ds$genesigs[,f.no+1],
                             #phenotype = as.matrix(temp[,1,drop=F])[,1], 
                             hits =  as.character(genes.f$genes))
rtna <- tna.mra(rtna)
mra <- tna.get(rtna, what="mra", ntop = -1)
print(head(mra, n=10))
```
```{r}
rtna <- tna.gsea1(rtna, nPermutations=100)
```
